inputs.text: This looks less like a spontaneous uprising and more like a numbers game designed to make one seem inevitable. Organizers are touting 8 million across more than 3,300 events in all 50 states, while the “about one million” figure and the claimed 600-event increase from October go largely untested. That convenient silence isn’t neutral: it lets a disputed estimate harden into apparent proof, serving whoever wants to dictate what the public supposedly believes. The real operation is shaping the story before anyone can question it.
